τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., in apposition: ’young, offspring’ (τέκος ἐλάφοιο ’the young of a deer’)

τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’put, give!’
τίφθ: τίπτε (τί ποτε) — why, what then?; interrog. adv., elided τίπτ’, and τίφθ’ before a rough breathing
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεοῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic τεοῖο (= Attic σοῦ), with a participle: ’you being (angry)’
τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’
τεύχεσιν: τεῦχος — armour, gear; neut. dat. pl., ν-movable
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’)
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’ · also masc. dat. pl., ’among them, to them’ (τοῖσιν … μετέφη ’spoke among them’)
τρωσί: Τρώς — a Trojan; masc. dat. pl. (Τρῶες, Τρωσί): ’Trojans’
τρόμος: τρόμος — trembling, quaking; masc. nom. sg.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’only so far’ · also correlative with ὅσον, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’so loudly, so much’
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’)
τῇς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic τῇς (= Attic ταῖς): relative ’to whom’
τῇσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ταῖς): ’to them, among them’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φαίδιμα: φαίδιμος — shining, splendid (of limbs); neut. acc. pl.
φλόγεα: φλόγεος — flaming, fiery; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted, agreeing with ὄχεα
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρονέων: φρονέω — think, intend, be disposed; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονῶν)
φώνησέν: φωνέω — speak, utter; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, accented before the enclitic τε
χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable (cf. epic χερσί)
χιτῶν: χιτών — tunic; masc. acc. sg., elided (χιτῶν’ = χιτῶνα)
χρυσάμπυκας: χρυσάμπυξ — with golden frontlet (χρυσός + ἄμπυξ); masc. acc. pl., of horses
χρύσειον: χρύσεος (Attic χρυσοῦς) — golden; masc./neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -ειον (= Attic -οῦν), agreeing with ζυγόν
χόλον: χόλος — anger, wrath (lit. gall, bile); acc. sg.
χόλος: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. nom. sg.
ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’ · also adj., gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’immortal’ (ἀθανάτων … θεῶν ’of the immortal gods’)
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη) · also fem. voc. sg., in address
ἀθηναίην: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. acc. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀκέων: ἀκέων — silent, in silence; adj., masc. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’silently’
ἀλαπαδνόν: ἀλαπαδνός — feeble, weak; neut. nom. sg., predicate with σθένος
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
ἀνακλῖναι: ἀνακλίνω — lean back, lay back, draw back; aor. inf. act.: ’to open (by drawing back)’
ἀναπλήσαντες: ἀναπίμπλημι — fill up, fill full; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having filled up’
ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
ἀπίθησε: ἀπιθέω — disobey (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, negated by οὐδέ: ’did not disobey’
ἀργείοις: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Achaeans/Greeks; masc. dat. pl.
ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀφεξόμεθ: ἀπέχω — hold off; mid. keep away from (+ gen.); fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἀφεξόμεθ’ = ἀφεξόμεθα): ’we will keep away from’
ἂμ: ἀνά (shortened and assimilated ἂμ before π) — up, along, over, among; prep. + acc.: ’along, across, over’ · also + dat., ’along, among’
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’)
ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’
ἄγριος: ἄγριος — savage, wild; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with χόλος
ἄλλοισι: ἄλλος — other; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις) · also neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι, agreeing with κτεάτεσσιν: ’the other (possessions)’
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency; with the subj. = future contingency, ’perhaps, may’ · also with the opt., potential: ’would, could’ (οὐκ ἄν τι φέροις ’you could not carry off anything’) · also ὅτ’ ἄν + subj., ’whenever’ (= ὅταν) · also ἀνά with apocope (ἄν τε μάχην = ἀνά τε μάχην): ’up, through’ + acc.
ἄντα: ἄντα — opposite, facing; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’opposite, over against’, following its noun
ἄντην: ἄντην — face to face, to the eye, in front; adv.
ἄξω: ἄγω — lead, take; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will take’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’which things’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμόν: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκνον · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν: ’my (heart)’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνδῦσα: ἐνδύω — put on, enter; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (strong aor. ἐνέδυν): ’having put on’, + acc.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξερέω: ἐξερέω — tell out, declare; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐξερῶ): ’I will tell’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’)
ἐπέμυξαν: ἐπιμύζω — mutter at, murmur at; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’muttered’
ἐπεμαίετ: ἐπιμαίομαι — touch, reach at, lay a hand on (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐπεμαίετ’ = ἐπεμαίετο): ’laid on at’
ἐπιθεῖναι: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, lay over; aor. inf. act.: ’to shut (by laying over)’ · also aor. inf. act.: ’to add’ (ἄλλ’ ἐπιθεῖναι ’to add others’)
ἐπιτέτραπται: ἐπιτρέπω — entrust, turn over to (+ dat.); perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’is entrusted’
ἐποιχομένη: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro at, go about, ply; go at, assail; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’)
ἐρέοντο: ἐρέομαι — ask, enquire; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἠρέοντο)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
ἐτεόν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, really’ (εἰ ἐτεόν ’if truly’)
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’)
ἑανὸν: ἑανός — fine, soft, flowing (of cloth; sense uncertain); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πέπλον
ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’ · also εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἔα (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’ · also ἐάω — allow; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= εἴα): ’allowed’
ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔκλιναν: κλίνω — lean, prop; turn back, rout (a force); aor. 3 pl. act., augmented
ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί)
ἔννεπε: ἐννέπω — tell of, relate, speak; pres. imper. 2 sg.
ἔντυεν: ἐντύνω (epic ἐντύω) — make ready, harness, equip; impf. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’was making ready’
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔρχεσθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθε): ’go!’ · also pres. inf. mid., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθαι), after φαίης: ’to be going’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχαδε: χανδάνω — hold, contain, have room for; aor. 3 sg. (χαδ-), + acc.: ’held’
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’ · also ’kept, guarded’ · also ’drove’ (ἔχον ἵππους ’drove the horses’)
ἕδος: ἕδος — seat, abode; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’was dragging’
ἕνεκα: ἕνεκα — on account of, for the sake of; prep. + gen.
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl.: ’we’
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἥρῃ: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. dat. sg. Ἥρῃ (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα)
ἥσθην: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 dual: ’the two sat’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδαίων: Ἰδαῖος — of Ida, Idaean; adj. gen. pl., agreeing with ὀρέων
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε): ’saw’
ἴδηθεν: Ἴδη — Mount Ida near Troy; Ἴδηθεν with suffix -θεν: ’from Ida’
ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
ἶρις: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. nom. sg.
ὀβριμοπάτρη: ὀβριμοπάτρη — epithet of Athena alone: ’of the mighty father’ (ὄβριμος + πατήρ); fem. nom. sg.
ὀδυσσαμένοιο: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry, be wroth; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with a gen. pronoun: ’you being angry’
ὀλοφυρόμεθ: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, grieve for (+ gen.); pres. 1 pl. mid. dep., elided (ὀλοφυρόμεθ’ = ὀλοφυρόμεθα): ’we grieve for’
ὀλύμπῳ: Ὄλυμπος (epic Οὔλυμπος) — Olympus, mountain home of the gods; masc. dat. sg.
ὀνήσει: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will benefit’
ὀρέων: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀρῶν)
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’)
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄλωνται: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., short-vowel (Attic ἀπόλωνται): ’may perish’; with κεν, ’shall perish’
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὄχεα: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. acc. pl., after ἐς: ’into the chariot’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
ὅττί: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; neut. acc. sg. ὅττι (doubled τ), accented before the enclitic κεν
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
ὑποθησόμεθ: ὑποτίθημι — put under; mid. suggest, propose; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (ὑποθησόμεθ’ = ὑποθησόμεθα), + dat.: ’we will suggest’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’)
ὠκέα: ὠκύς — swift; fem. nom. sg., epic -έα (= -εῖα), epithet of Iris
ὠκέας: ὠκύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ὧραι: ὥρα — season, time of year; fem. nom. pl.; personified Ὧραι, the Hours, keepers of the gates of heaven
ᾕρει: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’seized, held’
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’)
ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= ἑῇσιν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= Attic αἷς): ’in which’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
